name: bed12
description: The annotation's transcripts as BED12, one line per transcript, sorted by position: the gene-model format RSeQC and the UCSC tools read. DERIVED from the vault's own annotation with UCSC's gtfToGenePred and genePredToBed by bin/derive_annotation.sh. The name column is the transcript_id as the GTF writes it. thickStart and thickEnd are the coding region; a transcript with no CDS has them equal, the UCSC convention for non-coding. The tag is the annotation release, and the annotation asset is recorded as the parent.

required_files.description: the BED12 file written by the DERIVE_ANNOTATION process
JSON record of how it was derived

required_assets.description: the annotation asset and release this was derived from; always given explicitly, since its name depends on the provider
